address.description: Full or partial address of the property as shown on the listing card.
address.normalization: Preserve the address as shown. Do not geocode.

property_type.description: Type of property (e.g. 'Apartment', 'House', 'Studio', 'Villa'). Retain the site's original label.
property_type.normalization: Preserve the address as shown. Do not geocode.

bedrooms.normalization: Preserve the number as shown. Do not convert to a different unit.

bathrooms.description: Number of bathrooms (may be fractional, e.g. 1.5).

bathrooms_partial.normalization: Preserve the number as shown. Do not convert to a different unit.

floor_area.description: Floor/living area. Structured as {value, unit} where unit is 'm2', 'ft2', or 'sqm'.
floor_area.normalization: Preserve the original value and unit.

rooms.description: Total number of rooms (used on French and Moroccan sites where rooms ≠ bedrooms).

price_per_m2.description: Price per square metre. Structured as {amount, currency_code}.
price_per_m2.normalization: Preserve the amount and currency code.

sale_type.normalization: Preserve the sale type as shown.

tenure.normalization: Preserve the ownership tenure as shown.

monthly_fees.description: Monthly co-op/HOA/maintenance fees. Structured as {amount, currency_code}.
monthly_fees.normalization: Preserve the amount and currency code.

total_price.description: Total price including debt/fees (Finn Eiendom: asking price + joint debt). Structured as {amount, currency_code}.
total_price.normalization: Preserve the amount and currency code.

status.normalization: Preserve the listing status as shown.

published_date.description: Date the listing was published. Normalize to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).
published_date.normalization: Convert to YYYY-MM-DD and resolve relative dates using the snapshot date.

open_house_schedule.description: Scheduled open house dates/times (e.g. [{date, time_start, time_end}]).
open_house_schedule.normalization: Preserve the date and times as shown.

key_features.description: Short feature bullet points shown on the listing card.

description.description: Short description or teaser text shown on the listing card.

mls_number.normalization: Preserve the MLS number as shown.

additional_facilities.description: Additional facilities shown on the listing card (Leboncoin-specific).
additional_facilities.normalization: Preserve the additional facilities as shown.

images_urls.description: List of property image URLs from the listing card.
images_urls.normalization: Preserve the image URLs as shown.

listing_agent.description: Agent or brokerage info as shown on the card. May include name, phone, and/or photo.
listing_agent.normalization: Preserve the agent information as shown.

listing_agent_photo.description: URL of the agent's profile photo.

listing_agent_phone.normalization: Preserve the phone number as shown.

listing_office.description: Name of the listing agency or office.

parking.normalization: Preserve the parking information as shown. Do not convert to a different unit.
